_readme: Webhook trigger payloads for the two webhook-triggered Coupa workflows (Step 1, Step 3). Shape reverse-engineered from the built webhook + gate nodes: the blueprint gateway consumes only {status, taskID}; n8n exposes the POST body under $json.body (confirmed: gates read $json.body.status / $json.body.taskID). Replace <TASKID> with the seeded sandbox task's real taskID. Fire with tools/sandbox-seed/fire.sh <taskID> <webhook-url>, or curl directly. Use the /webhook-test/ URL + 'Listen for test event' while the workflow is inactive; /webhook/ requires the workflow ACTIVE.

step1._gateNotes: Gate chain requires, in order: body.status=='ADDED COMMENT TO TASK'; task.description contains '@CoupaWO;' AND task.statusID == '%PO Create%' statusID; latest comment contains 'status was changed' (ci) AND 'to PO Create'; task.meta1 EMPTY (idempotency guard). For the idempotency re-fire scenario, seed meta1 populated so 'No Existing Requisition?' exits early.

step3._gateNotes: Gate chain requires: body.status=='COMPLETE'; task.meta1 notEmpty AND task.meta2 notEmpty AND task.description contains '@CoupaWO;'. Seed the completed WO with meta1 populated and meta2=555001 (matches the mock PO id). The 'Upload Invoice Here' instruction present with a file for S3-1/S3-3/S3-4, without a file for S3-2.
